Company profile

ZYNP Corporation was established in March
1958. It has now become the world's largest manufacturer of cylinder liners,
the world's leading supplier of power piston assembly systems, and a
world-class end-to-end supply chain management service provider. The company
was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in July 2010 with stock code 002448.
Currently, it owns 26 wholly-owned, holding, and shareholding enterprises,
including 3 international joint ventures and cooperation companies, 3 overseas
subsidiaries of the United States, Germany; becoming dedicated to
engine parts, automotive electronics, smart driving, smart equipment, and
international trade. The multinational corporations that have developed in
various fields such as capital operations were selected as top 500 Chinese
manufacturing companies and top 500 Chinese private enterprises. Joint venture
with British GKN Group and Germany Rheinmetall Group to provide green,
environmental protection and energy-saving cylinder liners for the global
passenger car, commercial vehicle, construction machinery, agricultural
machinery, shipbuilding, garden machinery, air compressor and other
power fields. The complete set of friction modular solutions, the
leading product "Heyang Brand" cylinder liner covers an international
market share of over 15%, and the domestic market share reaches 45%.

ZYNP owns the
world's top 500 strategic partners, including GM, Ford, Chrysler, Cummins,
Caterpillar, Navistar, John Deere, Mercedes Benz, Volkswagen, Volvo, DAF, Fiat,
Peugeot and Citroen, as well as the domestic partners FAW, Dongfeng, SAIC, Weichai,
Sinotruk, Yuchai, Changan, YTO etc. ZYNP has established the big data and networking
management system focusing on the customer management, to provide 24 hours
services and best support for global customers. In recent years, ZYNP is
awarded "excellent supplier", "Diamond supplier",
"Platinum Award", "excellent supplier", "best quality
award" and "synchronous R & D Award" etc.

ZYNP
devotes to develop independent intellectual property rights to create industry
world standards. ZYNP has established 5 national high-tech enterprises, 5
overseas R&D centers, academician workstations, postdoctoral workstations,
national accreditation laboratory and 13 R&D centers for basic materials,
friction pairs, automotive electronics, intelligent driving and equipments.
Therefore ZYNP could realize the synchronous R&D with international
automobile and engine company. All products have independent intellectual
property rights. As the national standard makers for the industry of cylinder
liner, ZYNP has revised many standards accounting for 65% of the industry. Its technology
patents have occupied 70% in the industry. Every year more than 300 kinds of new
technologies, new processes and new products meeting Euro VI emission standards
and green manufacturing requirements could realize the industrialization, create new value for customers and lead the
development of the industry.

ZYNP Leads the internal control management system with
quality "Zero Defect" and reaches the international advanced level.
ZYNP has implemented much quality, environment and health management system,
such as ISO9002, ISO / TS16949, ISO14001, OHS18000, IATF16949:2016 and the lean
production, ERP, CRM, PLM and other informatization and standardization
management with the well-known automobile and engine companies in Europe and
America, which can meet customers’ personalized audit requirements. The company
has joined hands with the world's top 500 enterprises to synchronize with the
international internal combustion engine development, and win many awards such
as the national "Industrial Quality Benchmarking Enterprise", Industrial
Brand Cultivation Demonstration Enterprise, Henan Provincial Governor's Quality
Award and so on.

Everyone shares the concept of development results and
happiness index is increased year by year. ZYNP Shares the fruits of
development with society, employees and partners, such as, walker has its car,
home ownership housing. ZYNP grasps the national " One Belt One Road"
international layout, achieves sustainable and healthy development, has won the
focus and recognition of CCTV News, People's Daily, United States ARD, Chinese Daily
and the other mainstream media about the Group Development and is deserved of
high praise by the government at all levels, which shows the strong centripetal
force, cohesion and social influence of ZYNP.

Aim for a long time and walk forward. ZYNP
have seized the national “One Belt and One Road” initiative, supply-side
reforms, and China National Manufacturing Corporation's 2025 multiple overlapping
development opportunities. Delong Xue, Chairman of ZYNP Group, his “Three
Development Strategies” has outlined the new map of “international and
world-class” enterprise group. ZYNP Novotec (Shanghai) Tech. Co. Ltd has
successfully developed a variety of automotive electronically controlled
actuators of lightweight, small size, and highly integration, which have won
the favor of OEMs; The unmanned and man-machine interactive system intelligent
production line independently developed by ZYZX Wisdorm Industry, is
consistently praised by high-end customers such as Jaguar Land Rover, and
responsible for the new mission of “Made in China 2025” and pushes the
intelligent production technology to a new height; Shenzhen Vastfly Tech Co.
Ltd leads China's smart driving technology; Huayuanhengdao
Company and other industrial funds are quietly nurturing the industry
directions of new energy and new material. The successful operation of the
“State VI Engine Steel Piston Project” cooperated with the German Rhine Metals
Group has become the first domestic company to meet above Euro 6 emission
standard and provided a complete set of friction delivery of “cylinder liner,
piston, piston ring” for the high-end OEM market. The first overseas
acquisition is completed, which enriches the global operating platforms of
North America, Germany,and becomes the port where the products travele
in the group's industrial chain and is permanently opened. ZYNP Group
Development Working Conference in 2017 has sounded rapid development of 26
sub-companies in different fields, fully spurted the "Ten Billion
Group" target, and strived to build a global and world-class 100-year
enterprise group.

Warmly celebrate the 60th birthday of the Central Plains

The spring rain is
as oily, and on the morning of March 4th, it was bathed in drizzle, and ZYNP
was greeted with a 60th birthday.

The Industrial
Park Club is very happy inside and out. At 9 o'clock, golden salutes were
arranged on both sides of the gate. Group Chairman Xue Delong led the team from
the group building, crossed the salute queue, and met the couplet of “melting
self-confidence and casting world brands” and entered the club gate. Under the
watchful eyes of the cadres, he stepped onto the stage.

Today, the 60th
Birthday Celebration Ceremony was held in ZYNP and President Zhang Dongmei
presided over the conference. President Zhang used “to stand at this important
historical node, we are filled with joy and feel even more proud” to express
the common aspirations of the cadres and employees. With "Always
strengthen confidence, always seek momentum, and always adhere to the desire to
be bigger and stronger," summarize the main theme of the 60-year-long
advancement of ZYNP. With the efforts of generations of people in ZYNP, we have brought
together the world brand of 'ZYNP' to create a world of different countries,
different skin colors, different regions, and thousands of employees. Together, we have
created an outstanding enterprise that represents the comprehensive strength of
the industry, adds luster to the Chinese national industry, and develops and
shares results and actively rewards the society” to cover the achievements of
60 years of struggle. With “26 subsidiaries working together, synchronizing global industrial
technology upgrades with global multinational corporations, actively
collaborating with global resources, and eager to share corporate development
results with the entire society and all employees,” it shows the grace and
beauty of today's ZYNP.

The saluting
salvos rallied with joy, proclaiming the good wishes of all the people in the
Central Plains to redouble their efforts and initiate a new journey.

Chairman of the
Group Xue Delong delivered an important speech entitled "Converging the
power of the people to create a century of glory." Chairman Xue condensed
the history of the Central Plains' 60 years of forging ahead into the “Ten
Great Changes” and “Four Persistence”. The “Ten Great
Changes” let us see how Ningyuan Matching has been revived Nirvana again and
again from generation to generation. “Five Persistence” profoundly expresses
that the Central Plains match has evolved from “specialization” to “precision”
to “stronger”. Then, the chairman of the board used “a goal” and “five visions”
to describe the future of the Central Plains, and put forward the ambitious
goal of “building the Central Plains Matchmaking into a 'hundred-year-old shop'
and building a permanent foundation.” Finally, with the "Five
Visions," we will present an infinitely bright tomorrow to all cadres:
tomorrow, the development of the enterprise will be even stronger, the work of
all employees will be more "cool", and the life of the employees will
be more "beautiful". "The room for growth will be even
greater." The speech of the chairman of the board brought the thoughts of the cadres
from the past to the present. From now on to the future, the cadres and
employees are more confident and expectant about the future of the Central
Plains.

The backing of the
Central Plains is supported by tens of millions of families. The development of
the Central Plains is linked to the stability and happiness of thousands of
families. On that day, the villagers of many villages come from afar and bless
the Central Plains with wonderful folk art performances. In 2018, he stood at a
new starting point and created a new opening.

Chairman of the board of supervisors, Xue
jianjun, announced the start of the Spring Sports Meet. The staff have been
attracted from one site to another site by the slogan of the tug of war, the
sound of gongs and drums in front of the group building, and the colorful
lantern riddle inside the club.

Chairman of the Group, Xue Delong made an important speech at the award ceremony for the 60th annive

Good evening, everyone.

2018 is a special year. This year we will
celebrate the 60th anniversary of the establishment of ZYNP.

Here, on behalf of the group leadership, I
would like to express my highest respect to all the retired staff who have made
outstanding contributions to the development of ZYNP. I would like to express
our sincere gratitude to all the staff who have shared the same fate with ZYNP
for many years and devoted all their wisdom and strength to the development of
ZYNP.

At the same time, I would like to express our
greetings to all the staff who are still fighting in the global market. I wish
you all the best of the year!

There were
tremendous changes in the past 60 years.

It is the
60 years of developing by several generations of staff with arduous pioneering,
from small to large and continuous development. It is the 60 years of developingby advancing with the times, daring to
explore, and continuous innovating. It is the 60
years of tradition, talent and success. More, it is the 60 years of doing fine,
doing great and sharing results.

Recalling
the past, sighing with emotion! Enterprise development has never been easy. 60
years of trials and hardships, 60 years of thorny road, 60 years of remaining
true to our original aspiration and 60 years of persistent forward.

History will not
forget that in 1967, the Central Plains staffed with older generations of
cadres and employees, and organized by the political movement of the “Cultural
Revolution” for ten years, interfered with the two systems, and used the local
generation of oceans, self-manufactured equipment, independent research and
development, and successfully developed epoch-making significance. The
company's first generation product, the 1105 cylinder liner, has successfully
transformed its production from "agricultural machinery" to
"internal combustion engine parts", and has completed the
transformation from "hand-workshop-style production" to
"mechanized production" to make it bigger for the company. Strengthen
the development of "the only is contention, only crown is won"
development courage.

History will not
forget that in the beginning of enterprise restructuring in 2002, the solemn
promise of “five constants” was still in the ears, and “to wholeheartedly rely
on employees to run enterprises” became the unanimous voice and unified action
of the new period and the new leadership team. The account of history is also a
commitment to all cadres and staff. Accompanied by the integration of the
global economy, there have been fifteen years of ups and downs, fifteen years
of turbulent rains, and fifteen years of singing and dancing. The Central
Plains has consistently implemented the “internationalization” development
strategy and actively integrated into the global market to quench and temper.
Cummins, Ford, General Motors, Chrysler, Mercedes-Benz and Volvo, a world-class
customer, have brought disruptive revolution and technological revolution to
the Central Plains; "China-UK joint venture GKNZ" has become a model
of global cooperation; "China-Germany cooperation" Once again, it
demonstrated a miracle of speed; all cadres and employees “know their minds,
have methods, and dare to innovate” and live up to their expectations. Using
the “world's first” development performance, they wrote the development spirit
of “prospering the national industry and leading the industry first”.

History will always
remember that on July 16, 2010, bells ringing in the trading floor of the
Shenzhen Stock Exchange, the capital market journey in the Central Plains
sailed;

History will always remember
that on November 8, 2013, the ZYNP Group holds banners and flags, and more than
twenty subsidiaries gathered in Mengzhou to make the great achievement，

History will always
remember that on August 8, 2017, the group’s “three great strategies” were
officially released and implemented, and the group’s goal in the new era was
established. The great “blueprint” was drawn and the achievement about “tens of
billions” of sales revenue could be expected.

The higher you stand, the
further you can see. And we have the great mission, comrades, reviewing history
is to better face the future. With the joint efforts of all cadres and staff, ZYNP
has become a modern enterprise group with the complete industrial chain,
multi-industries involved, the prominent innovation, market share leadership,
and a certain international brand influence. In the argument that all walks of
life are generally plagued by the decline of internal combustion engines, and in
the face of the challenge of many contradictory issues and various risk, the
entire group of cadres and employees must always maintain a same voice and a
tone, and glory and dream should be converted to the courage of develop and a
powerful driving force for the implementation of the “Ten Billion Group” goal,
and strive for happiness and the future development:

In the future, ZYNP
should be given more responsibility. In addition to the continuous growth of
business performance and tax contribution to the community, ZYNP must also
uphold integrity management, green development in order to make ZYNP become the
cradle of Great countries "craftsmen", the benchmark of the cylinder
liner industry, and get the whole society’ praise and cheer.

In the future, ZYNP will authentically become a
"world class" brand. A great journey is started by taking the first
step. To make ZYNP into a national-level trademark and a world-class brand, we
must give up the illusion and delusion, and make excellent quality product,
research and develop the leading technology, and perform good services in the
entire industry chain to continue to enhance ZYNP’s fame.

In the future, ZYNP will constantly improve
the all the staff’s sense of happiness and acquisition. Our current income
level and social benefits praised by the Provincial Party Committee Secretary
are not our end, such as "Five One Insurance Fund”, “Welfare
in Four Seasons”, “Free Employee Meals”, “Free Shuttle Bus”, “Student Fund”, “Mutual
Fund”, “Car Subsidy”, “Communication Subsidy”, “House-purchase Subsidy”; We will
continue to make every effort to seek the welfare, increase the income, do
practical things and solve the difficulties for the staff, which is the solemn
promise of leading group to the staff. We want to let each member in ZYNP large
family have a stronger "Sense of Belonging", a more real "Sense
of Security", more "Sense of Gain" and higher "Happiness Index".

Friends, sixty spring and autumn has passed with
a mere snap of the fingers and expect another brilliant future.

Let us wish ZYNP a bright future, more
glorious and resplendent.

Thank you!

Ceremony for ZYNP 2012 Lean Production Project

ã€€ã€€On October 16th, ZYNP held the starting and swearing ceremony for 2012 lean production project, which officially starts the prelude. Chairman Xue Delong, General Manager Zhang Dongmei, A.brain President Wang Hongyan etc. attended the ceremony and made important speeches. More than one hundred people, such as middle-level and high-level cadres, lean production project managers, responsible persons of two institutions and group leader attended this meeting, whose host was Deputy General Manager Liu Dongping.

ã€€ã€€The Executive Deputy GM Dang Zengjun firstly introduced the lean structure, personnel allocation, rights and responsibilities, project content and objectives. Then he put forward the thoughts of pushing this project and the specific requirements. Team leader of A.brain lean project Liu Xu elaborated the significance, plans and goals of project cooperation. The directors of machining 3th, 4th, 5th workshop as the pilot unit for lean production respectively swore in this assembly to show their determination.

ã€€ã€€A.brain President Wang Hongyan expressed her wonderment and praise to our company. She presented that lean production must support the strategy. She hoped that we would realize the employeeâ€™s happiness index and physical index synchronously through the joint efforts of both sides.

ã€€ã€€General Manager Zhang Dongmei made important speech about three problems "why we need to push lean production, what is the significance of lean production and how to push" in the meeting. She pointed that at present our per capita output value is a lagging indicator. If the company was operated at coastal areas, it will be in crisis. Therefore ZYNP had chosen the lean project to train a management team with veteran soldiers and able captains, turning the company to a lean enterprise.

ã€€ã€€For â€œhow to effectively promote the lean production projectâ€, General Manager Zhang put forward five requirements: Firstly, the staff should be confidence and never yield. Secondly, pilot units should cherish the opportunity to do every step and every specific work. Thirdly, according to lean trainings, non-pilot units should focus on 5S and equipment security to develop self. Fourthly, according to lean trainings, functional departments should enhance their work efficiency. Fifthly, we hoped A.brain could guide project progress and the actual experience on site for non-pilot units. Through mutual efforts, we can get the achievement on training teams and improving efficiency.

ã€€ã€€Chairman Xue Delong delivered an important speech at the end of meeting. He evaluated that this conference was a passionate meeting. He pointed that the lean production was a systematic and long-term project. Except the passion, we must conduct an all-round improvement from ideology, finally complete our target "increase efficiency, eliminate waste, improve all aspects, increase benefit".

Zhangong Lu (Secretary of Provincial Party Committee) visits ZYNP

â€œYou are the best in the world with strength and a really high-tech enterprise.â€

On August 16, Mr. Zhangong Lu, Secretary of Provincial Party Committee,provincial people's congress standing committee, visited our company. Chairman, Mr. Delong Xue made a detailed report about the development of company. Jiaozuo Party Secretary, Guoxian Lu, Mengzhou Party Secretary, Chaojie Wei, General Manager, Mrs. Dongmei Zhang , Mr. Zengjun Dang, Mr. Dongping Liu etc. accompanied them to visit ZYNP.

Secretary Lu mainly visited the company product exhibition, flexible and automatic production line and production sites. During the visit, he carefully asked the company's system innovation ,science and technology innovation, development plan ,staff's life problems and so on. Chairman Delong Xue did detailed answers about industry status,technical innovation,development planning, market shares and so on. Secretary Lu praised that You are the best in the world with strength. You are really high-tech enterprise with powerful R&D institute and independent ability.

Secretary Lu message the company: the first is to adhere to innovate the system and mechanism, continue to make enterprise bigger and stronger; Secondly, we need to adhere to innovate science and technology ,constantly to develop new products, to expand product application field, not only do automobile, ship engine cylinder liner, also develop aircraft and other field space; Thirdly, we need to extend the related products chain, also make piston, piston ring industries special and big as doing cylinder liner, in order to form bigger and stronger development advantages, the enterprise collectivization and internationalization process to a higher level; Fourly;to develop enterprises at the same time, leading agricultural development and regurgitation-feeding agriculture, feedback society, drive development of the peripheral enterprises and township enterprises, to do more contribution to the society.

"Foreign Engineer" to do R&D, Great!

Secretary Lu very cared about technology innovation of company. When the Chairman Xue introduced there were three R & D centers in Europe, North America and China. Mr. Lu asked the engineers were foreigners or Chinese. The chairman said dozens of foreign engineers who researched and developed new product and new techniques worked in the R&D center. It is so great you could hire foreign engineers to do R & Secretary Lu said happily.

"You're really a high-tech enterprise!"

In the product exhibition area, Secretary Lu pointed to Cummins cylinder liner and asked what material it was. The Chairman Xue introduced that it was as-cast Bainite gray cast iron which we independent researched and developed, and obtained the national invention patent. Secretary Lu also asked accuracy of the cylinder liner. Chairman Xue said the ID accuracy could reach 1 um, equivalent to 1/20 of thickness of a hair. Secretary Lu understood that cylinder liner was one kind of part with high technology, not only at material, foundry, but also at machining.

During the Mazak automatic production line visit, Chairman Xue said that this production line was jointly developed and built by the domestic machine company and our company. And it was the most automatic in the national cylinder liner industry. Secretary Lu appreciated a lot that ZYNP was a really a high-tech enterprise because ZYNP has not only R & D centre, but also has R & D capability, not only produces high-tech parts, but also helps to develops new equipment.

There is confusion about the concept of high-tech enterprises. The company of manufacturing high-tech products is not necessarily the high-tech enterprise. Just like some electronic products, which the products are full of high technology, but the enterprise has no independent research and development ability, the enterprise uses "copy technology". So this kind of enterprise is not high-enterprise. ZYNP is high-tech enterprise! Secretary Lu said.

You are the best in the world with strength!

"In addition to adhere to scientific and technological innovation, adhere to the system and mechanism innovation, what factors make you enterprise to do so well," Secretary Lu asked . Chairman Xue replied: "We adhere to the specialization and internationalization. We specialized in the development of the industry of the cylinder liner.. The engine companies in world's 500 Top are our strategic partners. " "It is very good to uphold the specialization and internationalization development strategy. As long as you do fine and perfect in a part or a technical, you can make the enterprise in an impregnable position. There are several companies listed No. 1 in their industries. Now your enterprise is better and better, the new enterprises and competitors can not catch up in equipment, power, research and development ability and so on. You are strong because of doing special and you are the best of the world with sthength!" Secterary Lu appreciatively said.

To let worker be convenient in many ways ,great!

In sorching summer, Secretary Lu found that the production site is very cool and saw that workshop was equipped with central air-conditioning. "To save energy in some place,they don't let people use power and lights.They make people life uncomfortable. You are trying your best to save the equipment energy, but provide worker convenient environment.You committed to staff's environment improvement, make the staff feel comfortable, and you do very well with energy saving problem". Seeing staff's travel and in-service education information on the electronic screen, Secretory Lu asks the staff's working and living conditions from the chairman xue and General Manager zhang. Chairman Xue introduced the employee welfare construction. Secretary Lu felt delighted after hearing that. "These welfare-Central air conditioning, staff travel or in-service education- have increased the company cost. You think ways to consume energy for employees, which is really a good idea Secretary Lu said.
